product: Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe - Blue Ocean with Raised Relief

entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: your code, $20 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe - Blue Ocean with Raised Relief. What caught your eye?
I can't. It won't let me put it in.
That's because this one is sold out, I'm sorry. The same blue ocean look comes in a 12-inch Student Edition, so I'll put that on your screen.

I'm sorry, that Student Edition is sold out too. Blue ocean was what drew you in, so I'd like to find you something close.

Who is the globe for?
